text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking about the shopping
district...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Rice Shower watering flowers at
a flower
shop.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Some for you, and you... Phew. That
should do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? What are you doing here? I-I
mean,
welcome to the store...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's all my fault... I accidentally
knocked over
a flower pot, and the shop
manager tripped over
it and sprained an
ankle...
choice_data_list: Why is Rice watching the store?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm helping out today as an apology. I
just hope I
don't make things worse...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What? Y-you want to help? If you're
sure, then... I
would appreciate it a lot.
choice_data_list: Want me to help with the watering?
Shall I go put the flowers out on display?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the flowers here just so beautiful?
I think
the roses are especially pretty!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And when you water them, the petals
sparkle like
diamonds... I can't help but
be mesmerized by
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I chat happily as we
water the
flowers in the shop.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you... Please be careful. Some
of them
are pretty heavy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
These flowers are so pretty... I wonder if
we'd get
more customers if we displayed
a bunch of them
out front? Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eventually finish restocking the
inventory. It was
tougher than I
expected.
